results.title: Kuwait Ministry of Finance GIS
results.note: Describes State property-management GIS; not evidence of a complete cadastral lot feed.

assessment: The search found a Kuwait open geospatial hub and the Ministry of Finance's enterprise GIS, but the latter is scoped to state-owned real estate and public-property operations. No citywide private cadastral parcel vector endpoint was verified.
note: Native-language discovery only; does not change the historical registry or assert that no source exists.
